name: Alfhild
source:
Princess of Scandinavia and also a pirate. With her adventure and romantic spirit she want to become a legend, write the "Saga of Alfhild", and finally disappear without a sight. [spoiler]Fleed from the homeland with her servants as it was conquered by Third Reich Dokutsu[/spoiler] and was wholeheartledly engages in the pirate activity. Engages in various kind of adventured throughout the game.

Hates cold and Scandinavia, which is very cold space region.

"Heeeey! Are you filled with awe by the space pirate's captain Alfhild?!"
